title: Marty Burke, Harry's Bar, Omer Simeon and Marvin Saxby
summary: Allen runs through names, and Pecora recalls where Pomeroy and Wettling played and says Saxby was a friend.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you know Marty Burke, the drummer? Somebody had mentioned him to me. Marty Burke?
Martin Burke, yeah. Mmm. That's good to me.
Just about to run out of time here. And, uh, did you ever hear of Harry's Bar?
Harry, New York Bar? Yeah. Yeah, Chicago.
Well, Pomerate. That's where Pomerate was. Pomerate, not Jess Stacy.
Nile Wettland. Yeah. Nile, see? Yeah. Josh Wettland played there.
Did you know Omar Simeo? Clarinet player, a colored clarinet player? He used to work with Jolly Roll?
I heard of him. No, I heard of him. But you don't remember him.
And Marvin Saxby, did you ever know? Yeah. Oh, man, he's a good friend.
Yeah. Where do you know him from?

I just heard him on records, you know, and stuff. Oh, yeah? Yeah, yeah. Oh, yeah. He made some records with Muggsy and Vali Dufault and stuff. Yeah, yeah. You worked with Saxby, huh? Yeah, yeah. Who's band would that be?
Gee, I really don't know. I know it's, uh... Yeah, well, it's been so long.
